reviews.title: Air Key West - STAY AWAY unless you like unscrupulous companies!
reviews.text: Air Key West charged us $4,218.80 for a Havana Day Trip. The trip was booked on September 7, 2019 as a gift for my birthday; four of us were going in total. This was well before there was any knowledge of the COVID-19 pandemic. The round-trip flight and day tour were scheduled for March 13, 2020. The night before we were scheduled to leave, my husband, 2 friends and I were looking forward to going. However, around 10 PM the night before (March 12, 2020), the U.S. State Department issued a statement warning Americans who flew to Cuba that “travelers should be prepared for increased scrutiny when entering Cuba, particularly those originating from areas affected by COVID-19 or those exhibiting symptoms similar to COVID-19. Travelers requiring evaluation will be escorted to a designated healthcare facility. Those requiring quarantine will be transferred to select facilities to complete treatment in isolation for 14 days.” Considering that 2 of us were from New York City and two were from Massachusetts – both already deemed “hot spots” for the virus - we realized that we could be detained. Furthermore, a statement from Travel.Safe.Gov (the U.S. Department of State) warned that Cuba had no medical supplies and even advised that we would have to make masks out of our clothing! Also, that evening, the mayor of Miami-Dade, Carlos Gimenez, requested that flights from Cuba into the U.S. not be allowed. How could we be sure that such a request would not also extend to Ft. Lauderdale, when news and mandates influenced by the virus were changing hourly? Although we were extremely eager to go to Cuba, we knew that one of us was scheduled for a prostate biopsy on April 1 and another one of us was the sole caretaker of a spouse with Louis Body Dementia; therefore, we could not take the small risk of being detained. After much discussion, we decided to go to Air Key West’s desk at the airport at 7 AM (the time we were expected to report in for an 8 AM departure) on March 13 and explain that we could not in good conscience go to Cuba. We were hoping to split the difference or receive a credit for next year. At 7:05 AM, Air Key West pilot and owner Rob Valle entered the terminal and we immediately approached him with our dilemma. He told us he had heard nothing from the authorities and that it was our decision to not go. He acted as though he had no deciding influence on whether we could be refunded, split the difference or receive a credit for a later date; in fact, he did not volunteer at the time he was the owner. We saw that he had six passengers ready to go (the flight would be canceled if there were less than four passengers), so the plane was going to be taking off anyway. When we asked him what guarantee he could give us that we would not be detained, especially considering that we came from high risk areas, he said nothing. We were devastated, but we firmly believed we were making the right choice. However, we were stunned that considering the frightening and extraordinary circumstances of the situation, Mr. Valle was so devious and greedy. Then, on March 16, 2020, he sent my wife and me an email stating that “we take the health and safety of our crew and passengers with the utmost priority,” which obviously was not the case. He further accused us of “basing [our] decision not to go on the day trip merely on hearsay, inuendo [sic] and the general hysteria surrounding the Corona virus.” In addition, according to the contract we agreed to with Mr. Valle, “Customers…will also receive a refund or credit in case of operator cancellation due to weather or other unforeseen circumstances. (my italics, bolding and underlining).” Truly, this pandemic was indeed “unforeseen circumstances” and it should apply both to the airline as well as the topassengers. reviews.title: Patience Staff
reviews.text: In these trying times the staff of this flight was great. The panic of passenger and the chaos they caused was well handled by the staff of this air lines. Passengers were worried about getting home because of the virus and the efforts of this crew along with other flight crews on the plane was outstanding. Let us not forget the people behind the scenes such as check in staff, baggage handlers, phone staff and the CEO is a true measure of this company commitment to their passengers. West Jet remains the best airline to travel. A job well done
reviews.author: John S

reviews.title: The flight we took on West Jet was really great, good service, great food and very comfortable seats.
reviews.text: I cannot say enough great things about west Jet Airlines, we have been using them for years and years, we always chose them unless they do not go to a destination we have chosen, there is nobody better than this Air Line and if there was we would still use them because we are loyal customers. thanks
reviews.author: bev t

reviews.title: Fly non-stop only
reviews.text: Personable staff, great flight from London-Calgary-Kamloops Unfortunately flight home was LONG ....could have flown to Europe & back. Flight in Kamloops delayed 2 hours therefore missed connecting flight ....only flight available was at mid nite from Calgary to Toronto.....next flight Toronto to London ( 5 hrs later) .....so it was 18 hrs to fly from Kamloops to London, On Staff always helpful !
reviews.author: Angelina

reviews.title: Canadas best airline
reviews.text: West Jet provide outstanding service. The flight was full but still the service was friendly and good. mRecommend over Air Canada anytime
reviews.author: David H

reviews.title: Booking
reviews.text: Direct flights were my #1 priority. Both were changed. Changing dates home was the only way to get direct after booking months in advance. I was told that this was because of delay getting Max 8 aircraft
reviews.author: 684rossd

reviews.title: Personable
reviews.text: Paid for a premium seat. Comfortable. Free wine and snacks. Lots of leg room and free baggage check.
reviews.author: Kathleen B

reviews.title: A low cost alternative for a Fort Lauderdale trip from Toronto
reviews.text: We were taking a cruise from Fort Lauderdale which allowed us to fly down early to take advantage of some of the wonderful things Fort Lauderdale has to offer. The flight times were excellent and the flight crew were very professional and did their best to make sure you had a positive experience.
reviews.author: george s

reviews.title: Fun flight stewards and stewardesses are awesome.
reviews.text: Check in was a breeze.Great flight . Real nice landing. Everyone was so pleasant and helpful. Good movies on board.
reviews.author: dp4750

reviews.title: Great flight long wait checking in
reviews.text: The flight was great, the crew was great, the wait time to check in was almost two hours. The West Jet desk was understaffed. Thankfully, one loyal West Jet employee hung in there until we were all checked in. We were just in time to get to the gate.
reviews.author: ghryan

reviews.title: Everything went smooth except for a few turbulants
reviews.text: Seats crowded and a bit uncomfortable. Service quite friendly. Calgary airport is quite nice to get around if customs is involved.
reviews.author: conwayc2018

reviews.title: Flight was a single "hop" from Halifax, NS to Orlando, FL   prior to expected arrival  of Hurricane Dorian
reviews.text: See comments above and below. Airline crew and Halifax airport staff were all very helpful professional and helpful, as my wife uses a wheelchair or walker. Very smooth flight
reviews.author: Gail G

reviews.title: Sea and sun
reviews.text: Our trip was amazing, lots of fun in the sea and sun. While the trip was great...the flight was ok. Paid $900.00 for upgrades and the seat was a bit short...not very comfortable. Went to the casino, lost the $50.00 voucher they give you in 50 clicks (slots ). The food was good, sushi was great. We stayed at Grand Hyatt Bahar Mar, beautiful hotel. Went to Sandy Toes beach to swim with the pigs. Lots of fun, feeding the pigs. Beautiful island, would definitely recommend this Island.
reviews.author: _debmoulson

reviews.title: Good Flight
reviews.text: As a retired member of the Cdn Forces it was nice to have free luggage. Flight was on time and baggage was well looked after.
reviews.author: Victor G

reviews.title: Less and less leg room every trip
reviews.text: Every time we fly we are surprised at how there is less and less leg room in the plane. It is inhumane how airlines keep reducing the sitting space for passengers. The airlines are making it more and more unpleasant to fly which means we will fly less because of how uncomfortable it is. The seats do not recline more than 5 degrees making it really uncomfortable.
reviews.author: Doreen M

reviews.title: Not so good today!
reviews.text: We were late leavingCalgary by almost two hours! Just under the time by law, go figure. But made up time in the air, but still, with the Edo bus and ferry ride ahead of us, we did not get into Cozumel until 10 pm, having been at the airport by 7 :30 am! Made for a long tiring day. Only meal was breakfast and cookies on the plane. Usually WJ is a wonderful airline...
reviews.author: 279canadiantravelers

reviews.title: Choosing an Airline
reviews.text: It very much depends on your destination, when choosing an Airline. For Mexico. we use West Jet. For overseas we most often than not choose Luftanza or Air Canada. For us, the need is to get to a Regional hub for overseas or cross Canada flight. Also when choosing a short range flight 5 -6 hours we pay for Premium Economy. For overseas flights we book we book the same way, or First Class.
reviews.author: Evie370

reviews.title: West jet  was a nice plane. Way better than air canada
reviews.text: The west jest seats have a lot more cushion than aircanada and the seats still recline some... air canadas dont recline . No t.v.... so if you dont own something that down loads stuff you are screwed. Not everyone owns these things. I live were there is no cell reception so why would i own one .
reviews.author: sueenglish57

reviews.title: no issues
reviews.text: We had priority seats flight met expectations well treated by attendants and food was palatab;e but the choice is underwhelming
reviews.author: Stanley L

reviews.title: Slightly better than average budget airline
reviews.text: Chose this flight primarily as the shortest available and secondly because it avoided transitioning the USA. We got exactly what we expected and paid for in premium economy, on time, clean, efficient service. We did not drink or eat.
reviews.author: intervale

reviews.title: Home in under 2 hours
reviews.text: The flight was very comfortable considering the smaller plane and the short flight. Room for the carry on and the coffee in the morning offered was good...surprisingly!
reviews.author: O4707WOlindak

reviews.title: Great Customer Service
reviews.text: I flew from Ottawa to London and this is the first time that I was asked to move up my time while i was sitting at the airport. The customer service agent in Ottawa was outstanding. He was very professional and truly a credit to his organization.
reviews.author: John S

reviews.title: Very well run airline!
reviews.text: Everything was on time! Gate attendants were friendly and helpful. We had a small problem with a grandchild’s passport and they were helpful in getting a resolution.
reviews.author: Martin I

reviews.title: Quick flight to Vancouver
reviews.text: Our Flight was smooth and uneventful to Vancouver. The flight attendants were friendly and disembarking was quick. Once in the terminal, a attendant directed us to the baggage carousel which we appreciated.
reviews.author: shanec

reviews.title: No. 1 airline???
reviews.text: The announcement at the gate said West Jet was the no. 1 airline on TripAdvisor. Hmmm. My experience based solely on a return flight between Montreal and Toronto would suggest otherwise. There were some pluses - very helpful staff for example, but didn’t discount the biggest minus - that they couldn’t run a bath on time - outweighed them. Both flights delayed - first by 90 mins, second by an hour. Latter made for a buttock-clenchingly close onward connection.
reviews.author: Mike6258

reviews.title: Traveling on a West Jet Premium Econmy flight to Cancun
reviews.text: In April 2019, I booked a beach vacation to Cancun using Expedia and West Jet. I booked a Premium Economy flight and have to say that it was a memorable experience. From the customer service to the meals...everything was top-notch. Thank you West Jet!
reviews.author: Kim W

reviews.title: A nice plane!
reviews.text: Seats a a little space in between instead of none which is nice for elbows and sitting in one plane for hours.
reviews.author: sirputz2017

reviews.title: Would of been nice to be able to watch movies
reviews.text: Actually I was in premium economy and the seats were comfortable, food decent and flight attendants very nice. I was disappointed that I couldn't watch movies. It seems on this route they are still using an older version of plane which is a shame on a 5 hours flight.
reviews.author: CharlietheBlueJay

reviews.title: Screen- NONE!
reviews.text: No screen to watch makes a long flight even longer. Our family does not own a portable device. Would love to have the in seat option for a flight over 3 hours.. At least you provide snacks- something Air Canada doesn’t do.!
reviews.author: Pathfinder747899

reviews.title: Good Trip
reviews.text: I used West Jet's seat selection for the extra leg room and to be able to get off the plane quicker. No in-flight entertainment. I had downloaded a book and TV show to watch so was fine for me.
reviews.author: PrairieGirl_12

reviews.title: Westjet flight
reviews.text: Excellent. Always fly westjet to PV as it is direct flight.Inflight entertainment, use my IPad to watch a movie.
reviews.author: Barbara B

reviews.title: Great airline
reviews.text: Best airline I have flown on. Staff are always upbeat, helpful and have a great sense of humour. Once landed and passengers departed, the pilots took the two grandchildren into the cockpit and explained the different instruments. They were so excited to have their pictures taken with the pilots. A very memorable part of our Disney holiday. They did this even though both the pilots and stewardesses/stewards are responsible to clean the plane for the next flight. Something I did not realize. I fly Westjet when ever I can. Carol Reid
reviews.author: carol reid

reviews.title: I enjoyed the flight ,
reviews.text: The flight and crew were great. The trek across the tarmac. in the heat of the day (98 degrees) dressed in partial winter attire ! This is ludicrous. I am a senior and found the walk a bit much in the heat.If the airport can't handle the traffic at that time perhaps an earlier or later flight when the sun is not blazing hot would be better.
reviews.author: KathyGrey2015

reviews.title: Best deal to Edmonton
reviews.text: Quick flight, changes in Calgary nice staff easy airports to navigate. Great staff- very economical flight $$ wise and plane changes were quick and easy.
reviews.author: lorrainemO266OY

reviews.title: Home and back to work. Flawless
reviews.text: Took the early flight and needed de-icing but still able to keep close to schedule. Friendly staff on all flights and very accommodating to relocate people to empty seats to make room in crowded rows. The crew kept us all up to date on any delays because of waiting for tarmac crews and such.
reviews.author: BillSmith59

reviews.title: West Jet is the Best
reviews.text: Everything was perfect! Flight left on time, no rowdy passengers, it was smooth flying and it arrived on time.
reviews.author: Angie S

reviews.title: London to edmonton
reviews.text: Two long flights from Gatwick to Edmonton using west air were of a little concern such is the national of basic flight companies. No frills indeed, not helped by the bag check in freezing and staff helpless to assist. Service on board was basic and little hospitality beyond the minimum. In flight entertainment was better that I thought as you sImply load the app on to your iPad or phone and when on board you are connected.
reviews.author: Steve H

reviews.title: Wonderful friendly all around
reviews.text: Great airline. Good staff. Real friendly. Good pilot , snacks included. Very helpful when we needed assistance for mobility
reviews.author: HolidayBonny154937

reviews.title: Cheap Inflight Snacks
reviews.text: Seats are old, but confortable visual wear and tear. Inflight Snacks are really cheap which is the best part i think about the airline.
reviews.author: Shannon

reviews.title: Average
reviews.text: Usual flight nothing exceptional,but it is a short flight so really can't complain about anything.Staff was friendly and our flight was on time.
reviews.author: mike f

reviews.title: One of the worst flights
reviews.text: Due to last minutes and travel schedule, I was left with this only choice of flight by West Air. I was surprised that this is a budget airline. The air plane is an Airbus A320, a relatively small plane for such a long distance flight. The seat are narrow, worst of all budget airlines I ever took. The whole flying experience was one of the worst ones.
reviews.author: chle0ng

reviews.title: Good and Bad
reviews.text: Found going down jammed in like sardines, but going back for some reason had more leg room! Food expensive and not good, my sandwich was damp and soggy. Excellent wheelchair service at airport.
reviews.author: Pat H

reviews.title: Great Service and made sure we were confortable as I did have a Hip replacement
reviews.text: Wheelchair provided as requested both ends and they were waiting for our arrival!! Service was delightful and food was acceptable
reviews.author: Dan K

reviews.title: Terrible time to leave in the morning, 5am, however, great time to arrive in Cancun before 11 am
reviews.text: A direct flight to Cancun with a terrible departure time of 5 am but great arrival with a full day ahead in the sunshine. A little shut eye on board and all's well for a great day. Staff as usual were great and the flight uneventful.
reviews.author: Dave S

reviews.title: Budget airline
reviews.text: This is a CHEAP airline operate by chongqing don’t expect much from its,but from Singapore to fly to Chongqing at midnight arrived in morning a 5 hour flight for me I can expcept.
reviews.author: Chen T H

reviews.title: Very basic
reviews.text: No food, no water in the toile and no comfort. It was very cold on the flight, cold enough for my daughter to wear her coat during the flight. Very disappointed that West Jet has gone the way of the other airlines.
reviews.author: Susan B

reviews.title: West Jet-versus-all others:  Friendlier, but the service is the same!
reviews.text: Unfortunately,in modern flying,the flight itself is common and non-descript.The planes are all pretty much the same when it comes to economy class.They have pretty much got the seat dimentions down to the absolute minimum.I feel very sorry for those people who are anything above about-oh,let's say ten or twenty pounds past a size two!! Also ,for almost every flight ,they announce there is a shortage of overhead bin space and look for volunteers to check their luggage.Seems simple to me-x number of seats means x number of bin spaces-if -they stuck to the required carry-on size !
reviews.author: Mike E

reviews.title: Comfortable and on time
reviews.text: Good flight with nice attendants. On time and not overbooked like another airline. Staff was friendly and helpful.
reviews.author: Golfman90

reviews.title: A flight that felt like sauna
reviews.text: Imagine being in a sauna for 4 hours and 30 mins. I am a frequent flyer and Chinese airline are not particular stellar in both service or comfort but this has taken to a whole new low. The seats are so cramp but you can forgive that for the price you pay however not turning on the air-conditioner is disgusting. I asked the steward to lower the temperature but he told me that it is preset. He agreed to try after I argued that warm temperature in an enclosed environment with circulated air will result in manifestation of bacteria. I am not asking for comfort rendered by average airline considering West Air is ranked lower than most but having to fan yourself and perspire on the flight is a horrific experience. My advise to all travelers to avoid taking West Air unless no other alternative is available.
reviews.author: Starle07

reviews.title: Gate crew is very unprofessional
reviews.text: I sat and watched the 5 individuals at the gate tell passenger after passenger who were inquiring about the next flight which was a Delta flight that the gate was only for West Air flights and the laugh as the people went off trying to figure out what gate they should be at. Totally unprofessional I will never fly there airline.
reviews.author: Carl B
